market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver currently trades near $32/oz; reaching $120 by June 2026 would require a ~275% gain in ~15 months, an annualized return vastly exceeding any historical precedent. Even in extreme bull cases (hyperinflation, supply shock), such a rapid spike is highly improbable. The implied 6.8% probability dramatically overstates the true likelihood.
evidence_points: Silver spot price is ~$32 as of March 2025, requiring a 275% rise in under 15 months.
All-time high for silver is ~$50 nominal (1980), and the metal has never sustained a price above $50 for long.
Time horizon of ~15 months leaves little room for fundamental shifts or gradual demand growth; such moves are typically slow, multi‑decade trends.
sources_consulted: Current silver spot price (e.g., Kitco, CME Group)
